summary: Frontend-only verification of the PaymentModal wiring on /my-orders 'I Picked Up My Order' button. Source, built bundle, and rendered smoke test all confirm the two-step flow (open PaymentModal → onSuccess calls confirmCustomerOrderReceived and switches to COMPLETED tab). No customer auth available so full runtime flow was not exercised, per request.

issues: Pre-existing (from iteration_9) — 2 minified React #418 hydration warnings appear as pageerrors. Not blocking, unrelated to this change.

source_check.onSuccess_calls_confirm_and_switches_tab: line 71-94 handlePickupConfirm calls confirmCustomerOrderReceived(customerId, order.pickup_id) then setActiveTab('COMPLETED') ✓
source_check.modal_props: line 336-350: visible, onClose, onSuccess, merchantId=paymentOrder.merchantId, customerId, merchantName fallback, redirectTo='/my-orders' ✓

rendered_smoke.empty_state_shown: Please log in as a customer to view your orders.

regression.merchant-orders.tsx: Still imports/uses performMerchantOrderAction and confirmMerchantOrderDelivery — untouched ✓
regression.member-shop-details.tsx & member-navigat: PaymentModal usage unchanged; onSuccess/redirectTo signature compatible (signature = (amount, savings, paymentMethod) => void) ✓

verification_details.PaymentModal_signature_compat: onSuccess in my-orders ignores the (amount,savings,paymentMethod) args and calls handlePaymentSuccess(orderRef) — compatible.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In my-orders.tsx line 96-99, handlePaymentSuccess is a thin wrapper that only calls handlePickupConfirm. Could inline it, but not blocking.
Note: PaymentModal also calls router.replace(redirectTo) after onSuccess (line 206/260). Since redirectTo='/my-orders' and user is already on /my-orders, this is a no-op — good.
Pre-existing (P2): React #418 hydration warnings still present on /my-orders — same as observed on /merchant-orders in iteration_9. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: None — no OTP-based customer login possible in this env, per request
context_for_next_testing_agent: PaymentModal wiring on /my-orders is verified at source + bundle + DOM. To do a true end-to-end validation of the button → modal → Submit → UPI/Cash → confirmCustomerOrderReceived flow, an authenticated customer session with an order in PICKUP_READY status is required (not available in this environment). The 2 React #418 hydration warnings are pre-existing (iteration_9) and not caused by this change.
